chunks: Can one who knows that what has been revealed to you from your Lord is the truth be like one who is blind? Only those of understanding take warning.
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between those who know the truth and those who are blind according to Surah Ar-Ra'd?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the epistemological divide between the Ahl al-Hadith, who recognize the divine truth (al-Haqq) revealed to the Prophet, and the spiritually blind who lack insight. It underscores that true dhikr (remembrance) is not merely intellectual but a spiritual state exclusive to those with 'ulul-albab' (people of deep understanding), a concept central to Shia gnosis (irfan).
